name: kavach
description: Rights-in-the-moment agent for India. Corpus is UNVERIFIED placeholder law — see README.md before deploying to anyone.

scripts.install:all: for d in kavach-engine stt-service evidence-service app; do (cd "$d" && npm install) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:client: cd app && npm run typecheck && npm run units
scripts.verify: npm run validate && npm run test:engine && npm run eval && npm run test:evidence && npm run test:stt && npm run test:client
scripts.eval: cd kavach-engine && npm run eval && npm run eval -- --cases eval/holdout.json
